title: Super Charged Creepers
description: Adds the Super Charged Creeper, a purple variant of the Charged Creeper but way more explosive
body:
## Super Charged Creepers

A simple mod with one feature, the Super Charged Creeper. A more powerfull version of the Charged Creeper that causes even more destruction.

Creating a Super Charged Creeper is as simple as making a lightning bolt strike a Charged Creeper.

Do not let him get near your base.
![A big hole caused by the creeper](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1e8a390bc2b136d4443e556d283318db654321e6_0.webp)
